name: reload-nether
comment: WP-2.G review fix, the reload op in the nether (tests/golden/README.md "Reload" step 3). A netherrack floor, glowstone at (2,61,2), a chest at (3,61,-2) filled by slot_click with the player's 8 cobblestone, a player (id 0, whose Entity.dimension the harness never sets, so level.dat's Player compound says Dimension 0) and a pig (id 1). At t=5 the reload: the old world's provider is kept (WorldProviderHell), so the chunks are read back from world/DIM-1/region (SaveOldDir.java:11-20) and the blocks, the pig and the chest come back (at t=7-8 the new player takes the cobblestone back out of the chest); a null provider would have opened a surface world reading world/region and regenerated empty chunks there. Block, chunk_digest and entity_state dumps before and after.
